protocol: All claims must be traceable to machine-readable artifacts. No unsupported claim may remain.

claims.claim: V2 Dynamic SBG achieves AUROC=0.531 on N=744 test pairs
claims.test_independence: TEST split frozen before any V2 development
claims.note: CI barely clears 0.5; not statistically indistinguishable from random at conventional alpha
